newest.title: NVIDIA’s OpenShell Architecture: How Enterprises Can Finally Supervise Autonomous AI Agents
newest.description: NVIDIA’s OpenShell Architecture: How Enterprises Can Finally Supervise Autonomous AI Agents. NVIDIA just launched a new blueprint for keeping AI agents under control. We’re breaking down what this means for your company’s security and whether it actually solves the problem of autonomous agents running wild. What we covered: • NVIDIA launches OpenShell, a reference architecture for safe AI agents • Google Cloud Introduces Agent Compute Engine and Governance Framework • Meta Faces Investor Skepticism as AI Spending Escalates Following Q3 Results Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: If your company deployed an AI agent that made a mistake, who should be responsible: the person who built it, or the person who turned it o What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
